question: does the derived jump A_b (G159: rho_ph/rho_d at r_b = (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3, band 0.125-0.5, geomean 0.273) equal the committed dust law's value at r_b (G143: c_dust = 0.72 (M500/8e14)^-0.41 (r/R500)^-0.99); per-cluster rho_ph(r_b)/rho_d(r_b) vs A_b; the pinned combination of (c0, q); the full-derivation status with G182 in flight

chain.G159: A_b = (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3 = exp[dS/k_B] = exp[L/(N k_B T_b)], dressed potential-velocity form: band 0.125-0.5, geomean 0.2726, universal (G M(<r)/r = C)
chain.G143: dust law amplitude run: log10 c_dust = c0 + q log10(M500/8e14) + p log10(r/R500), c0 = -0.1445 +- 0.030, q = -0.414 +- 0.157, p = +0.990 +- 0.035 (12 committed amplitudes)
chain.G098: committed per-cluster density arrays (canonical floor-A): rho_ph_A = sqrt(G M_b(<r) a0)/(4 pi G r^2), rho_dust_req_A = rho_res - rho_ph, 140-pt grid 0.1-1.25 R500
chain.G182: IN FLIGHT (dispatched per WAVEBOARD; no files at lane time): sigma_d(r_b) exact -> A_b single number -> c0 COMPUTED

the_pin.pinned_combination: c0 + q log10(M500/8e14) at r_b: rho_d(r_b) = rho_ph(r_b)/A_b with the floor-A phantom and the (r/R500)^-0.99 envelope (the c0 direction)

full_derivation_status.status: ONE-PARAMETER EMPIRICAL + consistency: the jump pins the c0-combination (median R = 1.09, 12/12 inside the derived band); q's mass dimension remains MEASURED (-0.414 +- 0.157), CONSISTENT with the derived mass run (q_jump = -0.34 +- 0.27, within combined errors) but not independently derived (12-point power)
full_derivation_status.explanation: the boundary pins the c0-direction combination (rho_d(r_b) = rho_ph(r_b)/A_b; median R = 1.09); the q direction is consistent with the derived mass run but not independently derived; G182 (in flight) turns the c0-direction into a COMPUTED number (single A_b) and leaves at most q empirical

verdicts.V1_boundary_agreement: THE BOUNDARY AGREEMENT R: per-cluster ratio_committed(r_b) = rho_ph(r_b)/rho_d(r_b) from the committed laws (canonical floor-A phantom + rho_dust_req) vs the derived A_b = 0.273: median ratio 0.297 -> R = ratio/A_b = 1.09 (AGREE within 50% (PASS)); log-scatter 0.09 dex, IQR [0.22, 0.31], range [0.17, 0.33]; Spearman(R, M500) = +0.45 (p = 0.14); 12/12 clusters inside the derived band [0.125, 0.5]; coefficient cross-check c_dust(r_b)/A_b = 0.62 (the law's own amplitude at r_b, dimensionless temperature-coherency factor -- same order as the density ratio, not identical by construction)
verdicts.V2_pinned_combination: THE PINNED COMBINATION: the jump fixes rho_d(r_b) = rho_ph(r_b)/A_b per cluster; in the law's variables that is the ONE linear combination c0 + q log10(M500/8e14) (the c0-direction at r_b; rho_ph(r_b) from the floor-A law, envelope shape (r/R500)^-0.99 committed); the perpendicular direction (q's mass dimension) is pinned only if the mass run of rho_d(r_b) matches the law's q: q_jump = -0.343 +- 0.270 vs committed q = -0.414 +- 0.157 -> q CONSISTENT with the derived mass run (q_jump = -0.343 +- 0.270 vs committed -0.414 +- 0.157, within combined errors) but NOT independently derived (predictor se 0.27 > law se 0.16, 12-point power); the phantom density slope at r_b is -2 + (1/2) d ln M_b/d ln r ~ -1.06 (the '-1.7-ish' of the brief)
verdicts.V3_honest_statement: HONEST: the jump condition contributes a UNIVERSAL DENSITY RATIO at r_b = 0.62 r_M (A_b = (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3 = 0.125-0.5, geomean 0.273) that AGREES with the committed laws' boundary ratio (median R = 1.09, log-scatter 0.09 dex); it pins the c0-direction of the amplitude pair exactly (rho_d(r_b) = rho_ph(r_b)/A_b with the floor-A phantom and the r^-0.99 envelope shape), leaving q's mass dimension EMPIRICAL (but mass-run-consistent) on today's data; G182's sigma_d(r_b) closure (in flight) collapses the A_b band to a single number and turns the c0-direction into a COMPUTED number; the LAST cluster freedom: ONE-PARAMETER EMPIRICAL + consistency: the jump pins the c0-combination (median R = 1.09, 12/12 inside the derived band); q's mass dimension remains MEASURED (-0.414 +- 0.157), CONSISTENT with the derived mass run (q_jump = -0.34 +- 0.27, within combined errors) but not independently derived (12-point power)
